Healthy, cooling, filling & gut-friendly breakfast! Probiotic-rich, packed with iron, calcium, fiber & essential nutrients—perfect for weight loss & digestion ❤️ Light, satisfying & ideal for all ages, especially in summer ✨ Recipe: 🌿 Mix 2 tbsp ragi flour with 1 cup water to make a smooth slurry. In a pan, heat 2 cups water. Once it starts boiling, add the slurry and cook on medium flame till it thickens. Keep stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Let it cool completely. 🌿 In a bowl, add 1 cup fresh curd, 2–3 cups water, salt to taste, ¼ cup finely chopped onion, and 2 tbsp coriander leaves. Add the cooled ragi porridge and mix well. 🌿 Prepare the tadka: heat 1 tsp oil or ghee, add ½ tsp cumin seeds + mustard seeds, grated ginger, green chili, curry leaves, and a pinch of hing. Pour over the kanji. Enjoy! #ragimillet #raagikanji  #guthealth #healthybreakfast #milletrecipes

Let’s make Ragi mudde  A popular dish from Karnataka that replaces rice in a South Indian meal. Although an acquired taste, this humble dish packs in a ton of nutrition and is great to sop up any curry. In 2 cups of water, mix 1/2 cup ragi flour. Mix and boil until it is a little thick. This thick porridge-y concoction is Ragi Ambali, another spectacular dish. Take out 1/2 the ambali in a cup. Now to the remaining ambali in the pot, add in 1.5 cups of Ragi flour, mix coarsely, close the lid and set on the lowest heat/flame. After 10 mins, open the lid, turn off the heat and mix away until well combined.  I couldn’t show this part in the photos because one hand and not a professional tiktoker 🤷‍♀️ In a separate bowl laced with ghee and keeping a small bowl of water on the side, you add a nice chunk of the ragi mudde into the ghee bowl, wet your hands with the water nearby, and take the mudde to make a ball using the ghee bowl. A little knead and ball action gets it smooth and round into the perfect little mudde. Store in an air tight container until ready to consume. #ragi #ragimudde #food #india #indianfood

#creatorsearchinsights #fypシ゚viral__  Sejarah Ragi  Simak penjelasan lengkap nya dibawah: Sejarah Ragi: Dari Kuno ke Modern 1. Zaman Kuno – Dipake tanpa tau namanya   - 7000–6000 SM: Mesopotamia & Mesir Kuno bikin bir & roti pake ragi liar dari udara. - 2000 SM: Cina udah fermentasi arak beras & kecap pake ragi herbal. - Nusantara: Tape & brem muncul dari teknik fermentasi Cina-India. Ragi dibikin dari beras + rempah. 2.  Tokoh Penemu/Perintis Ragi 1. Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (1680): Pertama liat sel ragi pake mikroskop. Dia nyebut "animalcules" tapi belum tau fungsinya.   2. Louis Pasteur (1857): Buktiin fermentasi itu kerja mikroorganisme hidup. Dia jelasin peran Saccharomyces cerevisiae → bapak mikrobiologi.   3. Theodor Schwann (1837): Ahli fisiologi Jerman yang nyebut ragi sebagai tumbuhan hidup & penyebab fermentasi alkohol. Dia salah satu pencetus "teori sel". Sebelum Pasteur, Schwann udah bilang fermentasi = proses biologis, bukan kimia biasa. 3. Perkembangan Kuno → Modern Kuno:   - Ragi liar, hasil ga konsisten   - Ragi tape/arak dibikin manual dari bahan alam Modern:   - 1870-an: Ragi basah pabrikan mulai dipake   - 1940-an: Ragi kering instan populer pas PD II   - Sekarang: Strain ragi diisolasi & direkayasa di lab buat roti, bir, bioetanol, sampe obat Schwann + Pasteur ngebuktiin ragi itu makhluk hidup, bukan "sihir". Sejak itu manusia bisa ngontrol fermentasi.#kapanfyp #fandex #bismillahfyp
